products.name: Standard-duty storm-door closer, black
products.headline: Standard duty · 12-5/8 in
products.summary: One genuine Wright Products V1020BL black pneumatic closer for an outswinging light-to-medium storm, screen, home or security door. The closer is 12-5/8 inches long unextended, opens to 90 degrees, and has adjustable closing speed and seasonal latching adjustment. Use two standard-duty closers or a specified heavy-duty closer on a heavier full-view door.

specs.name: Latching
specs.value: Seasonal adjustment for screen or glass inserts

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Inswinging doors, commercial hydraulic-closer applications, or a heavy full-view door using one standard closer

exclusions: Not the Wright Products V150 heavy-duty closer.
Not for an inswinging door.
Do not specify one unit for a heavy full-view storm door.
Verify the existing bracket layout before treating it as a hole-for-hole replacement.

faqs.q: Will the V1020BL close a heavy full-view storm door?
faqs.a: Not as the recommended single-closer setup. Use two standard-duty closers or the specified heavy-duty closer for a heavier full-view door.

faqs.q: Does this closer fit an inswinging door?
faqs.a: No. V1020BL is designed for outswinging storm, screen, home and security doors.

faqs.q: Is the closing speed adjustable?
faqs.a: Yes. The pneumatic closer has an end adjustment for closing speed and force.

faqs.q: What should I compare before replacing an existing closer?
faqs.a: Confirm the door swings outward, is in the light-to-medium class, and that the existing jamb and door bracket locations can accept the included hardware.

products.name: One-inch rubber threshold ramp
products.headline: Exactly 1 in rise
products.fit: 44.5 × 9.5 in · beveled rubber · one cable channel
products.summary: One unbranded recycled-rubber threshold ramp for a measured 1-inch rise. It is 44.5 inches wide, provides a 9.5-inch approach, has beveled edges and a textured surface, and includes one underside channel for a cable. Measure the actual vertical transition; this is not a substitute for an accessibility-code or slope assessment.

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Transitions materially above or below 1 inch

exclusions: Not an ADA-compliance determination.
Not for a threshold whose measured rise is materially different from 1 inch.
Confirm the 44.5-inch width and 9.5-inch approach fit the doorway and landing.
Permanent mounting requires suitable fasteners and substrate.

faqs.q: What threshold height does this ramp fit?
faqs.a: A measured vertical transition of approximately 1 inch.

faqs.q: How much clear width does the ramp provide?
faqs.a: The ramp is 44.5 inches wide and 9.5 inches deep.

faqs.q: Can a cable pass underneath it?
faqs.a: Yes. The underside has one reserved cable channel.

faqs.q: Does buying this ramp make the doorway ADA compliant?
faqs.a: No. Compliance depends on the complete installed slope, landing, clear width, fastening and local requirements.

products.name: Four-foot dual-track bypass-door hardware
products.headline: Two 24.5 in doors
products.summary: One unbranded YMXT-XC40-4B four-foot dual-track bypass kit for two overlapping 24.5-inch door panels. It accepts panels from 1-3/8 to 1-3/4 inches thick and supports up to 150 pounds. The aluminum track, four wheel assemblies, two finger pulls, floor guide, stopper and installation hardware are included; door panels are not.

specs.name: Included
specs.value: Track, 4 wheel assemblies, floor guide, stopper, 2 finger pulls, wrench and installation screws

exclusions: Not for one 48-inch-wide panel.
Not for panels thinner than 1-3/8 inch or thicker than 1-3/4 inch.
Not the single-track variant.
Door panels and structural framing are not included.

faqs.q: What door widths fit this bypass kit?
faqs.a: Two overlapping panels measuring approximately 24.5 inches wide each.

faqs.q: What door thickness fits?
faqs.a: Panels from 1-3/8 through 1-3/4 inches thick.

faqs.q: Is this a single-track kit?
faqs.a: No. This exact four-foot variant uses a dual track.

faqs.q: Are the closet doors included?
faqs.a: No. The package contains the track and installation hardware, not the door panels.

products.name: Pocket-door track for 24–30 in doors
products.headline: 24–30 in door panels
products.summary: One unbranded YMXT-XC39-5 single-track pocket-door hardware kit for a 24-to-30-inch-wide panel from 1 to 1-3/4 inches thick. The 56.73-inch aluminum track and three-wheel hanger system support a door up to 220 pounds. Measure the panel, wall cavity and finished opening before ordering; the door slab and pocket framing are not included.

specs.name: Included
specs.value: Track, 2 three-wheel assemblies, 2 stops, floor knob, wrench and installation screws

specs.name: Not included
specs.value: Door slab and pocket wall framing

exclusions: Not for a door wider than 30 inches.
Not for a panel thicker than 1-3/4 inches.
Not bypass or bifold hardware.
The wall cavity, structural header, door slab and finish trim are not included.

faqs.q: Will this track fit a 32-inch pocket door?
faqs.a: No. The published door-panel range is 24 through 30 inches.

faqs.q: What door thickness fits?
faqs.a: A panel from 1 inch through 1-3/4 inches thick.

faqs.q: How much door weight can the kit support?
faqs.a: Up to 220 pounds when correctly installed into suitable structure.

faqs.q: Does the kit include the door or pocket frame?
faqs.a: No. It includes the track and moving hardware only.

products.name: Hollow screen spline, 0.125 in × 100 ft
products.headline: Exactly 0.125 in
products.fit: 100 ft · hollow serrated PVC · matching screen channels
products.summary: One 100-foot roll of unbranded black PVC screen-retainer spline with an exact 0.125-inch diameter and a hollow serrated profile. Use it only when the bare frame channel and the removed spline call for this diameter. It can retain screen mesh in matching aluminum or wood window, patio-screen, balcony-screen or pet-screen frames; a brand name alone does not establish fit.

specs.name: Compatible frames
specs.value: Screen-door and window frames with a matching channel

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Channels requiring 0.140, 0.175, 0.220 inch or another profile

exclusions: Not interchangeable with 0.140-, 0.175- or 0.220-inch spline.
Not compatible based on screen-door brand alone.
Screen mesh and installation roller are not included.
Measure the old spline and the bare channel before ordering.

faqs.q: How do I know whether 0.125-inch spline fits?
faqs.a: Measure the removed spline and the bare frame channel. Order this roll only when the required diameter is 0.125 inch.

faqs.q: Can it be used on a patio screen door?
faqs.a: Yes, when that door's screen-retainer channel requires a 0.125-inch hollow round spline.

faqs.q: Is the spline solid?
faqs.a: No. It has a hollow serrated PVC profile for flexibility and grip.

faqs.q: Are mesh and a spline roller included?
faqs.a: No. The package is one 100-foot roll of spline only.

products.name: Eight-foot J-hanger barn-door kit
products.headline: 3.7–4.3 ft door
products.summary: One unbranded 004-2.44M eight-foot black steel barn-door hardware kit for a single 3.7-to-4.3-foot-wide panel from 1.3 to 1.8 inches thick. The two-piece track and J-shaped hangers are rated for a door up to 330 pounds. Door slab and load-bearing wall structure are not included.

specs.name: Included
specs.value: Track, 2 J hangers, anti-jump hardware, 2 door stops, floor guide, spacers, fasteners and installation tool

specs.name: Not included
specs.value: Door slab and structural wall reinforcement

exclusions: Not the I-hanger or double-door variant.
Not for panels narrower than 3.7 feet or wider than 4.3 feet.
Not for panels thinner than 1.3 inches or thicker than 1.8 inches.
The wall and header must safely support the complete moving load.

faqs.q: What door width fits this kit?
faqs.a: One panel from 3.7 through 4.3 feet wide.

faqs.q: What door thickness fits?
faqs.a: A panel from 1.3 through 1.8 inches thick.

faqs.q: Is this the double-door kit?
faqs.a: No. This exact eight-foot J-hanger kit is for one door.

faqs.q: Does the package include the door slab?
faqs.a: No. It contains the track and mounting hardware only.
